sentences.text: I have gone through the record and proceedings.
It is seen that the land in this appeal and the land in the above appeal are situated at the same village.
The land was acquired for the same project under the same notification and the same award.
The market price of the dry crop land has been determined @ of Rs.4,46,050/- per hector by the reference 71. fa 143.22.
covered
judgment
land acquisition.odt Court.
It is seen that the land in this appeal was dry crop land.

Perusal of the decision in First Appeal No. 358 of 2020 with other matters would show that the land in First Appeal No. 358 of 2020 and the land in the present appeal are similarly situated in all respect.
The present appeal is, therefore, fully covered by the decision rendered in First Appeal no. 358 of 2020.
I, therefore, conclude that the compensation awarded by the reference Court is just, proper and reasonable.
No interference is warranted in the judgment and award passed by the reference Court.
Therefore, I answer the above points in the affirmative.
In view of this, the appeal stands dismissed.
6 The first appeal stands disposed of, accordingly.
No order as to costs.

Pending applications, if any, stand disposed of.
(G. A. SANAP, J.) Namrata Signed by: Miss Namrata Suryawanshi
